description: Arriva Bike is a shared-mobility system listed in the GBFS registry used by Mobility Database. Its listed geographic coverage is Nitra, country code SK. The registry System ID is nextbike_as, and the listed GBFS versions are 2.3. The descriptive metadata name ARRIVA Slovakia a.s. Sturova 72 949 44 Nitra as the operator. The discovery metadata advertise station descriptions, station availability, available-vehicle status. The JSON auto-discovery endpoint links to the system's published components. Auto-discovery returned HTTP 200 during the metadata check. The registry does not state feed-use charges; the licence field retains any provider declaration found in system-information metadata. Station and vehicle data were not downloaded, and current operation or completeness is not established by a registry listing. The resource can provide shared-mobility supply inputs for transport accessibility, network and capacity studies when the relevant components are available. The related Mobility Database catalogue record documents the discovery source.
